visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men stand in a well-lit exhibition room filled with mineral specimens. One man on the left wears a green button-down over a black shirt and glasses, holding a professional camera. The man on the right wears a light beige t-shirt and glasses. They stand before a glass display case containing white mineral clusters on shelves. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a modern museum setting with a clean, professional aesthetic. (2) The man in the green jacket holds a smartphone horizontally, filming the mineral specimens inside the display case. His facial expression is focused yet amused as he looks through the screen. The other man gestures toward the specimens with his hands while talking. Large yellow and white text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame, accompanied by smaller variety-style captions and logos. (3) The camera follows the men as they walk through the museum hallway. Glass display cases containing various colorful rocks and minerals line the corridor walls. The environment is spacious with a light green color palette on the walls and warm overhead lighting. Both men are walking at a casual pace, occasionally looking back toward the camera or interacting with each other as they move. (4) As they approach a brighter area near an exit or another hall, the man in the beige shirt waves a finger dismissively in a playful manner and begins to walk out of the frame. The man in the green jacket follows shortly after, laughing. The scene ends with a view of the organized mineral display cases in the background under bright studio-style lighting.
